translations.web: The governor told that they should not eat of the most holy things until a priest stood up to minister with Urim and Thummim.
translations.bsb: The governor ordered them not to eat the most holy things until there was a priest to consult the Urim and Thummim.
translations.kjv: And the Tirshatha said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
translations.asv: And the governor said unto them, that they should not eat of the most holy things, till there stood up a priest with Urim and Thummim.
